name: Shelfmark
short_desc: Self-hosted book and audiobook search & request hub
author: calibrain
description: Shelfmark is a self-hosted web interface for searching and requesting books and audiobooks across multiple sources (web, torrent, usenet, IRC). It integrates with metadata providers (Hardcover, Open Library, Google Books) and library tools like Calibre, Calibre-Web, Calibre-Web-Automated, Grimmory, and Audiobookshelf. Multi-user support with built-in request system and approval workflows.

form_fields.label: Search Mode
form_fields.hint: 'universal' uses metadata providers (recommended), 'direct' queries configured sources directly

form_fields.label: Enable Tor routing
form_fields.hint: Route traffic through Tor (requires root startup, NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW capabilities)

form_fields.label: Enable file logging
form_fields.hint: Write logs to /var/log/shelfmark/ inside the container

form_fields.label: Log level
form_fields.hint: Application log level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR)
